description: This file contains the server-side code-behind for the MCQExam page in an online examination system. It handles loading multiple-choice questions from a database based on the selected course, managing session variables for questions and answers, handling quiz submission and scoring, and implementing a timer for the exam duration.

classes.name: MCQExam
classes.description: Code-behind class for the MCQExam ASP.NET page, managing question retrieval, session state, timing, and user interactions.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Initializes the page by loading questions from the database based on the course stored in session and setting up the timer.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation back to the dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Navigates to the user profile page.

methods.name: submitB_Click
methods.description: Calculates the user's score based on selected answers, stores it in the database, and redirects to the result page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user and navigates to the login page.

methods.name: Timer1_Tick
methods.description: Updates the countdown timer display and handles exam timeout.
